pageTitle: FolderTree: Turn a folder into a README tree
headline: Turn a folder into a README tree.
subhead: Choose a folder to create a tree you can copy into Markdown.
privacy: Your files stay on your device. Nothing is uploaded.
patternsHelp: Comma-separated names. Use * and ? as wildcards, for example *.log. Matches names at any level.
fenceLabel: Wrap copy in a Markdown code fence
copyFailed: Copy failed. Select the tree and copy it manually.
noticeFileLimit: This tree is cut off at the first {shown} of {total} files.
noticeNodeLimit: This tree is cut off at the first {shown} of {total} items.
noticeReadLimit: Reading stopped after {limit} items, so this tree may be incomplete.
noticeUnreadable: Folders that could not be read: {count}. This tree may be incomplete.
errorEmpty: No files found in that folder. Empty folders can't be read with Choose folder. Try dropping it instead.
errorNotFolder: That doesn't look like a folder. Drop a folder, not a file.
errorOneFolder: Drop one folder at a time.
errorRead: Couldn't read that folder. Please try again.
errorUnsupported: This browser can't open folders. Try a desktop version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
tipPrompt: Found this useful? Leave a tip.
noteNames: Only file and folder names are read. File contents are never opened.
noteEmptyFolders: Empty folders may be missing when you use Choose folder, because browsers can only list the files inside a selected folder. Drag and drop keeps them.
noteBrowserPrompt: Your browser may ask you to confirm an "upload" when you choose a folder. That is its standard wording for sharing the folder with this page. Nothing leaves your device.
noteLimits: Trees are cut off at 5,000 files or 10,000 items, and reading stops after 200,000 items.
footerNoTracking: No tracking, no cookies, no ads.
